name: Crateline
oneLiner: Pallet freight between Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane — depot to door, one waybill, tracked to the pallet.
paletteSeed: freight paperwork on bone paper — near-black ink, unbleached bone/kraft, container safety-orange as the ONE loud colour, oxide stamp red for stamped marks; stencil white on ink panels
typeDirection: Saira Stencil One (container-marking display register, clean cuts, never distressed) + IBM Plex Mono (manifest/data register, tabular numerals) + Archivo variable (workhorse body) — all OFL, vendored
motionBudget: stamps move, structure doesn't: ink stamps thunk in (hero IN TRANSIT, tracking line sequence, form LODGED), the tracking wire draws, data-panel counters tick once, the waybill status cycles like a depot board, a cursor floodlight over the hero yard on fine pointers; depot ticker belt; reduced-motion gets everything static and pre-stamped, no-JS shows all content
